editorial_policy.pricing_and_availability: Any frontend values must be explicitly labeled demo; this evidence file contains neither.
editorial_policy.historical_models: Some photographed models are older. This is not a claim of current manufacture, sale or stock.
editorial_policy.identity_scope: Only brand/model/category and Pixel Rose finish are asserted; no storage, connector or hardware SKU inferred.
editorial_policy.rights_status: Photographers explicitly license these photographs on Commons. Copyright reuse is conditional on attribution, applicable share-alike and change notices. No manufacturer endorsement, trademark clearance, or warranty of other third-party rights is implied.
editorial_policy.publication_gate: Public-facing linked attribution and license notices must be implemented before deployment; keeping this research doc alone is not public attribution.
